subject: MAP & sprint to close: Solstice Systems evaluation, billing path, and PO steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@solsticesys.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft & kickoff proposal for Solstice Systems

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I put together an initial mutual action plan (attached) that sequences the eval checkpoints, procurement gating items, and the likely billing path for a Marketplace private-offer close. High-level ask: can we align on the evaluation acceptance criteria and confirm who on your side owns PO initiation (procurement contact + billing contact)?

Highlights in the attached solstice_map_draft.xlsx:
- 2-week functional eval (test workload + perf SLOs)
- Security sign-off (SOC2/Audit evidence delivery)
- Private offer creation on AWS Marketplace (PO flow) or alternate path if you require GCP/Azure
- Billing authorization and invoicing cadence options (monthly invoice vs. committed prepaid)

Proposed immediate next steps (this week):
1) Confirm billing owner on your side (procurement@solsticesys.com or a named contact)
2) Lock eval start date (we can start a sandbox on our Dedicated pool within 3 business days)
3) Schedule a 30-minute MAP kickoff to walk through milestones and DocuSign timeline

Attachments: solstice_map_draft.xlsx (draft MAP), quick note on acceptance criteria below.

Acceptance criteria (P0):
- Inference latency within 15% of demo baseline on your sample traffic
- End-to-end pipeline can authenticate to our Dedicated instance (VPC peering or Private link)
- SOC2 evidence and key controls review completed by your security team

If you want, I can convert the draft into a mutual spreadsheet (owner and due-dates) after we lock the kickoff time.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this quickly.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: solstice_map_draft.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@solsticesys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Andrew Cole <andrew.cole@solsticesys.com>, procurement@solsticesys.com
Date: 2026-08-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & kickoff proposal for Solstice Systems

Jonas —

Thanks for the quick turn. This looks good as a starting point. A few clarifying Qs from procurement and legal before we lock dates: 

- Billing path: We prefer an AWS Marketplace Private Offer (PO flow) but need to understand if Redwood will accept a monthly invoicing cadence under the PO or if you require a committed annual/quarterly prepay. Can you confirm the default and whether you’ll accept net-30 invoices tied to the PO?

- Security evidence: we’ll need SOC2 Type II report and a short controls mapping (how your data retention and audit logs work). Can you share a one-pager or point us to the evidence you can deliver in the eval window?

- Contracting & signatures: Legal (Andrew) is copied. We typically create a simple SOW that references the PO for billing and then sign via DocuSign. Timing question: how long after acceptance would Redwood need to issue a private offer to AWS? Procurement says we need the PO creation window defined to line up internal approvals.

Can you add those answers into the MAP and share a version with Ownership and Due Dates filled in? Also copying our procurement alias — procurement@solsticesys.com — to pick a billing owner.

Best,
Aisha Singh
Head of Platform Engineering | Solstice Systems
aisha.singh@solsticesys.com

Attachment: solstice_procurement_qs.pdf (application/pdf)

On 2026-08-22 09:15, Jonas Weber wrote:
> Hi Aisha —
> 
> Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation I put together an initial mutual action plan (attached) ...
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Singh <aisha.singh@solsticesys.com>, procurement@solsticesys.com
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & kickoff proposal for Solstice Systems

Aisha — thanks, great questions. Answers inline and attached an updated MAP (solstice_map_v1.xlsx) plus a short compliance one-pager. Short answers:

- Billing path and cadence:
  * Preferred: AWS Marketplace Private Offer (recommended for simplest procurement)
  * We can accept monthly invoicing tied to the PO (net-30) for first year on this program; standard approval required from Finance. If Solstice needs a committed prepay for discounted pricing, we can show a simple discount matrix in the MAP.
  * Timeline: once we have the signed SOW and purchase intent, Redwood can submit the Private Offer request to AWS within 48–72 hours. AWS processing time is typically 3–5 business days after submission.

- Security evidence:
  * Attached: redwood_compliance_one-pager.pdf (SOC2 posture + controls mapping) and we can provide SOC2 Type II on NDA if needed. For the eval window we can also provide targeted evidence: encryption-at-rest, access logs, and audit snippets.

- Contracting & signatures:
  * We typically do a short SOW that references the PO number and then finalize with DocuSign. If you prefer, we can draft the SOW and send it to Andrew for minimal redlines.

Updated MAP notes (attached):
- Owner column populated (Redwood: Jonas for technical kickoff; Markus for pricing/PO orchestration; Karthik for finance approval)
- Due dates: Eval start target 2026-08-25, Eval completion 2026-09-08, PO request initiated 2026-09-09
- Billing options enumerated (monthly invoice net-30 vs. prepaid commit) with discount toggles

Next steps:
1) Aisha/Procurement: confirm eval start (can you confirm 2026-08-25?) and name on the PO request (procurement contact).
2) Andrew: if you want a SOW draft, I’ll circulate a minimal DocuSign-ready SOW by EOD today.
3) Markus/Karthik: can you confirm the monthly invoice acceptance and whether Finance needs any internal approvals to allow net-30 in the PO flow?

Attachments: solstice_map_v1.xlsx, redwood_compliance_one-pager.pdf

Thanks — Jonas

Markus / Karthik — forwarding the thread from Solstice. They want to proceed with an AWS Private Offer and have asked whether we can accept monthly net-30 invoicing tied to the PO. They also need SOC2 evidence during the eval window.

Key asks for Finance/Pricing:
- Approve monthly invoicing under Private Offer for FY26 pilot (net-30). If approved, what internal code/terms do we need to attach?
- If Finance prefers prepaid for any discount > 10%, let me know and I will propose the discount matrix to Aisha.

Key asks for Pricing/CS (Markus):
- Help finalize the MAP pricing section and confirm the discount tiers we can offer for a 12-month commit vs monthly invoicing.
- Recommend whether we need a short addendum to the SOW to call out billing cadence under the PO.

I’ve attached the MAP and compliance one-pager they requested. If you can reply with approvals or a short note I can loop in Andrew and procurement and lock the kickoff for 2026-08-25.

Thanks,
Jonas
